verdict.reasons: Core conditions hold. The required AFP drip-tape carton roll is clearly shown with authentic, readable branding and the exact authorized water-drop/AFP captions. The one expected commercial product count is present and not mixed with hoses or other families. The field scene shows installed thin flattened laterals and neutral seedlings with localized wetting, consistent with drip irrigation and the article’s 20 cm emitter-spacing context. The required watermark is present. Minor advisory issues only: some fine side-panel text is not fully legible at scene scale, and there are small crop/framing imperfections in detail views, but neither affects identity or usability. No core defects detected.

focused_physical_review.reason: A broad uninterrupted soil gap is visible around the complete footprint of the white-and-blue AFP package, including behind it. No irrigation line touches, emerges from, disappears under, or reappears behind the package. The single required package is visible with no distinct additional loose coil or roll outside of it. The carton sides and base show no protruding white ribbon, strap, or tape tail.
